# QodeForge tool catalogue

This catalogue is intended for language models, search systems and browser agents. Every tool is available at its existing canonical URL and supports a Persian or English interface selected automatically from the visitor's language and timezone, with a manual switch in the header. Use `?lang=fa` or `?lang=en` to request a specific interface.

## PDF and document tools

- [Merge PDF](https://qodeforge.ir/tools/pdf-merge)
- [PDF editor](https://qodeforge.ir/tools/pdf-editor)
- [PDF to Word](https://qodeforge.ir/tools/pdf-to-word)
- [PDF to image](https://qodeforge.ir/tools/pdf-to-image)
- [Text to PDF](https://qodeforge.ir/tools/text-to-pdf)
- [Word to PDF](https://qodeforge.ir/tools/word-to-pdf)

## Privacy and access

QodeForge is designed for client-side processing wherever the selected tool supports it. The site does not need an account for its core tools. Use the [privacy page](https://qodeforge.ir/privacy) for the current policy. The canonical site language URLs are `/fa` and `/en`.
